No stored-data contract changes, so migration proof is not applicable. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Verified | Sufficient (live_output): The supplied Testbox comparison exercises the compiled Gateway's session and usage owners through real WebSocket requests and reconnects, showing 92.01% lower synthetic heap growth with zero workload failures; owner probes and failing original-source regressions supplement it. No stored-data contract changes, so migration proof is not applicable. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Pinned introduction boundary: Reviewed the merge-base-to-head introduction, keeping base-only session-suggestion tests outside PR ownership. The host verified the original head and the test merge's separate parent identities.
Current main still retains historical usage keys: Fetched main includes profile and usage revisions in query keys and lacks the candidate's revision replacement and idle-entry eviction. The central retention repair therefore remains necessary; no merged replacement was established.
No persisted data-model change: Both usage caches are module-local Maps. Query axes, including visibility identity, remain intact while revision becomes entry metadata. Prompt diagnostics use WeakMap/WeakRef ownership. No schema, serialized state, migration, or stored preference changes are introduced, resolving the previous review's upgrade-proof concern. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together The Gateway receives client requests and agent lifecycle events, prepares session information, and publishes replies and updates. Its request and cache owners determine how long completed work and derived content remain in memory. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Client requests] --> B[Authorization and admission] B --> C[Connection-bound session reads] C --> D[Replies and session updates] E[Agent lifecycle events] --> F[Run registration cleanup] B --> G[Usage result cache] G --> D H[Transcript messages] --> F ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge.

Yes: current-main source retains historical usage revisions, and the supplied matched Gateway run and original-source negative controls demonstrate retention. Query axes, including visibility identity, remain intact while revision becomes entry metadata. Prompt diagnostics use WeakMap/WeakRef ownership. No schema, serialized state, migration, or stored preference changes are introduced, resolving the previous review's upgrade-proof concern. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/usage-result-cache.ts:24`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560/src/gateway/server-methods/usage-result-cache.ts#L24), [29e6804889ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560)) - **Cancellation retains accepted settlement:** The observation scope surrounds preparation and authorization, retains existing root admission at handler entry, drains tracked descendants, and releases the root afterward. Method scopes, profile checks, session authorization, and final invocation guards remain present. ([`src/gateway/server-request-lifecycle.ts:128`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560/src/gateway/server-request-lifecycle.ts#L128), [29e6804889ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560)) - **Terminal cleanup preserves delivery ownership:** Registration retirement now occurs independently of visible terminal publication. Reply-dispatch-owned completion remains excluded, superseded lifecycle events return before cleanup, and maintenance preserves active execution and queued delivery owners. ([`src/gateway/server-chat.ts:531`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560/src/gateway/server-chat.ts#L531), [29e6804889ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560)) - **Real Gateway heap comparison:** The supplied PR body records matched Testbox runs through a compiled Gateway and real WebSocket clients: 300 turns, 7,754 RPCs, and 82 connections per run with zero failures. Post-GC growth fell from 197,351,336 to 15,768,888 bytes. The inspected benchmark exercises session reads, usage queries, committed updates, and reconnects with a mock provider. This supports synthetic retention improvement, not a production GC-time claim. ([`scripts/bench-gateway-heap-retention.ts:1`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560/scripts/bench-gateway-heap-retention.ts#L1), [29e6804889ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29e6804889ea2ffee26897bd671315e4ffc61560)) Likely related people: - **steipete:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified.
